document.title: Deutsche Trial-Meisterschaft: ADAC Trial Weekend - 1. Lauf zur Deutschen Trial- Meisterschaft 2026
discrepancies: The live page (…_trial-live-results.html) lists every starter and ranks them on the day; this PDF lists only riders scoring for the DM and re-ranks them (e.g. MELCHIORI 7th here, 8th on the live page; OSSEVORTH 4th here, 6th on the live page).
OSSEVORTH Durchschnitt 2.53 here (76/30, marks only); the live page prints Ø 2.60 (78/30, marks plus time penalty).
document.notes: Championship version with WP points. Klasse 6 (Open Pokal) is omitted. Zeit is blank for riders whose finish time was not captured; they are still ranked. Footer '26.4.2026 10:09, Seite n'.

misfits.what: Each rider prints two affiliations: a club and an ADAC regional club (or the DMV). person.club holds one string.
misfits.suggestion: Replace person.club with person.affiliations[] {type: club|regional-club|federation, name}.

misfits.what: The sheet is a championship-filtered classification: riders not scoring for the DM are left out and the rest re-ranked, so ranks differ from the day result on the live page. The PDF itself does not say so; kind 'eligibility' plus free-text filter is the only place to put it.
misfits.suggestion: Add classification.ineligible_handling: removed-reranked | listed-unranked | listed-ranked, and classification.scope (e.g. 'DM').

misfits.what: classification.counts is typed for mark counts but the header prints entrant counts (Genannt/Gestartet/Ausgefallen/Im Ziel/Gewertet).
misfits.suggestion: Add classification.entrant_counts {entered, started, retired, finished, scored}.

misfits.what: Equal totals in Klasse 3 (three riders on 11) are ordered with no printed reason; tie_break cannot be marked as inferred.
Durchschnitt (average mark per section) printed per rider.
misfits.suggestion: Add optional total.average or declare it derivable.

misfits.what: Lane colour is printed only as a coloured swatch beside the class name; difficulty order of the lanes is not printed, so route.order stays null.
misfits.suggestion: Add route.inferred or route.order_source so a mapper can record an order taken from class numbering.

mapping.unread: Nothing unread. The 7 sampled riders were mapped by hand; the other 58 were added later by parsing the PDF text layer. Every rider's marks agree with the printed lap sums, mark counts and Punkte, and the parser's output matched the hand-mapped riders. For nos 222 and 508 the regional club wraps into the first three marks in the text layer; their marks were checked against the trial-live page.
